Delivery Note — Lines

This screen displays all line items from delivery notes in a comprehensive table format.

It provides a detailed view of all products and services delivered across all delivery notes, allowing you to analyze deliveries at the line-item level.

Use this screen to review delivery patterns, track specific items across multiple delivery notes, or verify quantities delivered to customers.

Each row represents a single line item from a delivery note, showing the item details and quantity delivered.
